[TOOL_CALLS]={"input":"Run this graph query to find the Perimeter top's electricity and occupancy sensors' series ids:

SELECT \n  (VALUEOF(Labels(?) AS TEXT)) AS point,\n  ref:hasTimeseriesId AS timeseries_id \nWHERE \n  graph:building_0 \n  <> ? \n  .

The query expects to be completed with variables for electricity and occupancy sensors.

Run this command with the series ids to fetch the data:

python3 -c "from evdb.buildings.query_timeseries import QueryTimeseries; QueryTimeseries([<electric timeseries id>, <occupancy timeseries id>]).csv()""}
